keywords: Critical thinking 2.Developing opinions 3.Academic vocabulary development 4.Reading comprehension
educationalGoal: This course aims to develop student's academic English skills with a particular focus on critical analysis of academic texts, building academic vocabulary and reading comprehension. Through group discussion and teamwork activities, students will learn how to approach and interpret information, challenge ideas, express opinions and cultivate intellectual independence. This course is ideally suited for students who wish to enter graduate school programs in which English is an essential skill.
advice: The course will comprise the following units: Unit 1 - Environment Unit 2 - Technology Unit 3 - Society Unit 4 - Culture In this course, students are expected to actively participate in classroom activities, including group discussion, opinion sharing, and constructive feedback. Students will read a variety of English texts and develop their higher-level English vocabulary knowledge. Students will be expected to complete regular homework activities, quizzes, and oral presentations.
requiredKnowledge: Completion of either English Topics 5, Academic Reading 1, Academic Reading 2 or STEM English

activityGoals.body: Be able to apply thinking tools to analyse a culturally diverse range of problems
Be able to identify main ideas and supporting details in academic texts
Formulate clear and concise arguments and opinions in written and oral form
Develop and effectively use academic English vocabulary skills
Develop critical thinking skills by identifying preconceived ideas, conclusions, and assumptions
Develop a mindset of viewing information and problems from different perspectives
